ChangeLog: V8 Changelog -> No more whole different UI elements for settings of features, now all the settings will be hidden inside the feature and when you want to show them you just press the arrow next to the toggle, saving so much space and making the UI much more readable, this also allows me to make more settings instead of only the fully needed ones. -> Side frame of the pages/tabs is now smaller so there's more room for actual content and less empty space. -> Added Save Settings Expanded State in Settings page. -> Added Quests dropdown and Charge While Traveling settings to Auto Quest. -> Added Capsules dropdown setting and Brawler Capsule to Auto Capsule Farm. -> Added Play Animation, Remove Slow and Cancel On Run settings to Auto Block. -> Added Skip Flung Targets setting to Use Moves, preventing moves from being wasted on flung targets. -> Improved Auto Raid, now destroys Majin Buu bits when he is going to reform. -> Converted the 4 Target dropdowns in Auto page into a single Targets multi dropdown and selected values of this dropdown will now always be moved to the top. -> Bugged Character in Character page is now always visible because I think that 95% of people didn't know of it. -> Collect Lootables now handles better interactions with other autos enabled at same time. -> Dash Vanish TP is no longer triggered while charging ki. -> Configuration list dropdowns are now searchable. -> Moved ESP NameTags and Players ESP Trace inside Players ESP settings, Reputation and Hard Quest options inside Auto Quest settings, Dungeon Mode, Dungeon List, Kill All Enemies, Auto Collect Components and Auto Healing Chamber inside Auto Dungeon settings, and Raid Mode and Raid List inside Auto Raid settings. -> Removed all Waiting For Essentials notifications except one for less spam and unnecessary descriptions on some settings. -> Auto Assist doesn't use assists while target is flung anymore. -> Fixed Custom Dash Strength sometimes making dashes infinitely strong and causing errors after prolonged use. -> Fixed native roblox names still showing up for new players or after dying with ESP Name Tags. -> Fixed Acrylic Blur getting disabled when changing in game map zones if you kept the UI visible.
